annotations.title: Score a day of tasks (One-Day Tally)

description: Scores tasks on four yes-or-no tests (repeats weekly, follows a pattern, 80% draftable, low risk) and picks the one job to start with. Also estimates weekly hours handed back for that job. An estimate, never a promise.

draft_share.description: Share of the time a draft plausibly hands back. Default 0.6.

tasks.description: The tasks from one normal day.

draftable_80.description: A good first draft would get it most of the way.

follows_pattern.description: It is done about the same way each time.

low_risk.description: A wrong draft costs a minute, not a customer.

minutes_per_week.description: Minutes this takes in a normal week.

repeats_weekly.description: It comes back at least once a week.

name: score_daily_tasks
